# FG-SYS-0005

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`server-start-failed`](../../ops/runbooks/server-start-failed.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `serve_failures_have_their_own_code` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: サーバーが停止しました。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The server stopped. Contact the administrator.
- id: Server berhenti. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

forge serve could not build its async runtime, or the HTTP server loop failed after binding (an I/O error on the listener), or graceful shutdown exceeded its deadline.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The `context` field contains `operation=` (`build_runtime`, `serve`, `shutdown_deadline`); the OS error is in `source`. Check file-descriptor limits (`ulimit -n`), memory, and the system log around the time.

## 対処 (fix)

Address the resource problem (descriptors, memory) and restart; for shutdown_deadline find the long-running requests in the access log.
